project.title: Consumer Demand Signal: Where Spending Is Holding Up in 2026
project.summary: A consumer analytics case study that combines retail sales, consumer sentiment, and income-segment card-spend data to show where demand is resilient and where discretionary pressure is still visible.

article.title: Consumer Spending Is Not One Story
article.summary: A detailed walkthrough of how I used Opportunity Insights and FRED data to analyze category resilience, income-based spending differences, and what those signals mean for consumer strategy.
